## Checklist
- [ ] A test fails without this change (TDD), and `make check` passes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]` (and docs, if behavior or setup changed)
- [ ] No real network details: addresses, MACs, device names, tailnet names, tokens or logs
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
